pages.text: 1. Craft and equip the $(item)Crane Backpack$() in your chest slot.$(br2)2. Hold the $(item)Crane Control$() in your main hand.$(br2)3. Hold right-click to $(bold)lower$() the magnet; sneak+hold to $(bold)raise$() it.

4. Left-click (air, block, or entity) while holding the control to toggle the magnet: grab mobs, items, or blocks, then left-click again to release.$(br2)The tip hangs ~2 blocks ahead of you at yaw height — lower it onto the target before grabbing.
